# DB Watcher

DB Watcher is a lightweight, zero-dependency schema introspection library for Go. Mount a real-time, interactive database schema dashboard directly onto your web application.

## Key APIs

### watcher.NewInspector

Detects the underlying driver and returns the matching Inspector implementation.
Signature: `func NewInspector(db *sql.DB) (Inspector, error)`

Supported drivers:
- `*sqlite3.SQLiteDriver` (github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3)
- `*sqlite.Driver` (modernc.org/sqlite, pure Go)
- `*pq.Driver` (github.com/lib/pq)
- `*stdlib.Driver` (github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib)
- `*mysql.MySQLDriver` (github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql)

Instrumented wrappers implementing `Unwrap() driver.Driver` are resolved automatically. Unknown wrappers fall back to dialect probing.

### watcher.HTTPHandler

Serves the interactive ERD dashboard (HTML) or raw JSON schema.
Signature: `func HTTPHandler(inspector Inspector) http.HandlerFunc`

- HTML dashboard: standard browser request
- JSON: `?format=json` query param or `Accept: application/json` header

JSON shape: `{ tables: [{ name, cols: [{ name, type, pk, fk, notNull, default, unique }], indexes: [{ name, unique, columns, partial }] }], relations: [{ src, srcCol, tgt, tgtCol }] }`

### watcher.NewDiffer / Differ.Watch / watcher.ChangesHandler

Track schema changes between snapshots.

```go
d := watcher.NewDiffer(inspector)
d.Snapshot(ctx)
d.Watch(ctx, 5*time.Second, func(err error) { ... })
http.HandleFunc("/changes", watcher.ChangesHandler(d))
```

`ChangesHandler`: GET returns latest diff, POST takes a new snapshot then returns diff.
`Differ` persists the last non-empty diff — changes stay visible until a new migration produces a fresh diff.

SchemaDiff shape: `{ before, after, addedTables, droppedTables, modified: [{ table, addedColumns, droppedColumns, typeChanges: [{ column, before, after }], addedIndexes, droppedIndexes }] }`

## Dashboard Features

- **ERD view** — draggable cards, animated FK relationship paths, click to highlight connections, double-click to collapse
- **Changes view** — built into the same UI via tab switcher, renders the SchemaDiff from ChangesHandler
- **Global search** — `⌘K` or `/` to filter tables; filter persists after closing the overlay
- **Zoom** — `Ctrl+`/`Ctrl-`/`Ctrl+0`, mouse wheel + Ctrl/Cmd
- **Persistent layout** — card positions and collapsed states saved in localStorage
- **Light/dark mode** — follows OS preference, togglable, persisted in localStorage
- **Live updates** — polls schema every 1.5s, diff every 3s; updates without page reload

## Testing

Integration tests use Testcontainers for Go (requires Docker).

```bash
go test ./...                          # unit tests
go test -tags=integration -v ./...    # full integration tests
```
